label: PF Backlog 208
title: Backend: OpenTelemetry GenAI observability (spans incl. multimodal prompts/responses)
body:
## Problem / why
We have bespoke telemetry; industry uses OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic conventions - incl. multimodal
prompts/responses and MCP call tracing.
## Goal
Emit OTel GenAI spans (agent reasoning, tool calls, model calls, MCP calls, media units) with cost/latency.
## Acceptance criteria
- A run produces OTel spans consumable by any OTel backend; per-span cost/latency present.
## Verification
- Export spans to a local collector; assert span hierarchy + attributes.
